Photo File Section, UNIT 2 varag'i. Bet raqami yo'q (varaq qirqib olinadi).

Betda 7 ta odamning rangli surati bor va har birining ostida ISMI bosilgan: Amy, Eric, Frank, Max, Yoko, Lee, Lester.

⚠ Unit 1 varag'idan FARQI: u yerda nomlar bosilmagan edi, bu yerda ISMLAR BERILGAN. Sababi — Unit 2 mavzusi odamni TASVIRLASH, ism topish emas. O'quvchi ismni biladi va tashqi ko'rinishni tasvirlaydi.

Betda boshqa yozuv yo'q — vazifa unit mavzusidan tushuniladi.

sections.title: Photo File - Unit 2: Describe the people

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 2 - Look at the photos and describe the people: Amy, Eric, Frank, Max, Yoko, Lee, Lester.
exercises.explanationUz:
BETDA 7 TA ODAM — HAR BIRINING ISMI
BOSILGAN.

⚠ UNIT 1 VARAG'IDAN FARQI:

  UNIT 1 varag'ida nomlar YO'Q edi —
  o'quvchi joyni TANIB olishi kerak edi.

  UNIT 2 varag'ida ISMLAR BERILGAN —
  chunki vazifa boshqa: odamni
  TASVIRLASh.


UNIT 2 NING ASOSIY SAVOLLARI:

  'What does he/she LOOK LIKE?'
     → TAShQI KO'RINISh
     (tall, short, fair hair, blue eyes)

  'What IS he/she LIKE?'
     → XARAKTER
     (kind, funny, friendly)

  ⚠ Bu ikkisini chalkashtirish — eng ko'p
  uchraydigan xato (2-nazorat testi,
  8 va 9-bandlar).


TASVIRLASh QOLIPI:

  'This is Amy. She is old. She has got
   short white curly hair. She wears
   glasses.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Bu — Emi. U keksa. Uning kalta oq
   jingalak sochi bor. U ko'zoynak
   taqadi.'


⚠ 'HAVE GOT' va 'WEAR' FARQI:

  HAVE GOT → tana a'zolari
     'She HAS GOT blue eyes.'
     'He HAS GOT a moustache.'

  WEAR → kiyim, ko'zoynak
     'She WEARS glasses.'
     'He WEARS a tie.'

  ⚠ Ko'zoynak KIYILADI ('wear'),
  mo'ylov esa BOR ('have got').


⚠ ISMLAR TURLI MADANIYATLARDAN:

  Amy, Eric, Frank, Max, Lester
     → G'arb ismlari
  Yoko
     → Yapon ismi
  Lee
     → Xitoy/Koreya ismi

  Kitob ataylab turli xalq ismlarini
  qo'ygan — Unit 1 da mamlakat va millat
  mavzusi bo'lgani uchun.


⚠ IKKI JUFT SURAT:

  Eric va Frank — bitta suratda (aka-uka
     bo'lishi mumkin, ikkalasi ham chiziqli
     kiyimda)
  Yoko va Lee — bitta suratda (ikki qiz)

  Bu — TAQQOSLASh uchun qulay:
     'Eric is taller than Frank.'
     'Lee has got longer hair than Yoko.'


YOSh BO'YIChA GURUHLASh:

  KEKSA:        Amy
  O'RTA YOShLI: Lester
  YOSh:         Max
  BOLALAR:      Eric, Frank, Yoko, Lee


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a cardigan  = kofta
  a vest      = mayka (sport)
  a basketball = basketbol to'pi
  floral      = gulli (mato)
  striped     = chiziqli
  a fringe    = kokil (peshonaga tushgan
                soch)
  wrinkled    = ajinli

pairs.right: old; short white curly hair; glasses; a red cardigan
pairs.rightUz: keksa; kalta oq jingalak soch; ko'zoynak; qizil kofta
pairs.whyUz:
Suratdagi eng KEKSA odam.

'She is old. She has got short white curly
hair. She wears glasses.'

⚠ 'WEARS glasses' (kiyadi), lekin
'HAS GOT hair' (bor).

pairs.right: a boy; short dark hair; a striped jumper
pairs.rightUz: bola; kalta to'q rangli soch; chiziqli sviter
pairs.whyUz:
Frank bilan BITTA suratda — chapda turgani.

'He is a boy. He has got short dark hair.'

⚠ Frank bilan TAQQOSLASH mumkin:
'Eric is taller than Frank.'

pairs.right: a boy; short fair hair; a striped jumper
pairs.rightUz: bola; kalta och rangli soch; chiziqli sviter
pairs.whyUz:
Eric bilan BITTA suratda — o'ngda turgani.

Sochi Ericnikidan OCHROQ.

'Frank has got fairer hair than Eric.'

pairs.right: a young man; short dark hair; a moustache; a red sports vest; a basketball
pairs.rightUz: yigit; kalta to'q soch; mo'ylov; qizil mayka; basketbol to'pi
pairs.whyUz:
Qo'lida BASKETBOL TO'PI bor — demak
sportchi.

'He is young. He has got a moustache.
He likes playing basketball.'

⚠ 'play basketball' — artikl YO'Q
(sport bilan).

pairs.right: a girl; dark straight hair with a fringe; a floral dress
pairs.rightUz: qiz; to'q rangli tekis soch, kokil; gulli ko'ylak
pairs.whyUz:
Lee bilan BITTA suratda — chapda turgani.

Sochi KALTAROQ va peshonasida KOKIL bor.

⚠ 'Yoko' — YAPON ismi.

pairs.right: a girl; long dark hair; a floral dress
pairs.rightUz: qiz; uzun to'q rangli soch; gulli ko'ylak
pairs.whyUz:
Yoko bilan BITTA suratda — o'ngda turgani.

Sochi UZUNROQ.

'Lee has got longer hair than Yoko.'

⚠ 'Lee' — XITOY/KOREYA ismi.

pairs.right: middle-aged; fair/grey hair; a moustache; glasses on his jumper; a tie
pairs.rightUz: o'rta yoshli; och/kulrang soch; mo'ylov; sviterida ko'zoynak; galstuk
pairs.whyUz:
Ko'zoynagi taqilmagan — sviteriga OSILGAN.

'He is middle-aged. He has got a moustache.'

⚠ Max bilan solishtiring: ikkalasida ham
mo'ylov bor, lekin Max YOSH, Lester
O'RTA YOSHLI.

groups.explanationUz: Bu varaqda ikkalasi ham kerak bo'ladi.

items.derived: hair, eyes, a moustache, a beard
glasses, a tie, a jumper, a dress

items.derivedUz: mo'ylov esa BOR: have got a moustache

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ 'LOOK LIKE' ↔ 'BE LIKE' — Unit 2 ning asosiy farqi

items.derived: tall, short, fair hair, blue eyes

patterns.formula: This is [ism]. He/She is [yosh]. He/She has got [soch]. He/She wears [kiyim].
patterns.exampleEn: This is Amy. She is old. She has got short white curly hair. She wears glasses.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu — Emi. U keksa. Kalta oq jingalak sochi bor. Ko'zoynak taqadi.
patterns.explanationUz: Asosiy qolip: ism → yosh → soch → kiyim.

patterns.exampleEn: Eric is taller than Frank. Lee has got longer hair than Yoko.
patterns.exampleUz: Erik Frankdan baland. Lining sochi Yokonikidan uzunroq.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ikki juft surat (Eric+Frank, Yoko+Lee)
ataylab TAQQOSLASH uchun qo'yilgan.

patterns.formula: He HAS GOT [tana a'zosi], but he doesn't WEAR [kiyim].
patterns.exampleEn: Max has got a moustache, but he doesn't wear glasses.
patterns.exampleUz: Maksning mo'ylovi bor, lekin ko'zoynak taqmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'HAVE GOT' — tana a'zosi;
'WEAR' — kiyim va ko'zoynak.
